name: Ask-before-Plan
description: Ask-before-Plan is a benchmark dataset designed to evaluate proactive agent planning capabilities, where language agents predict clarification needs, invoke external tools, and generate plans to fulfill user demands in real-world scenarios.
reputation: A recent benchmark for proactive planning and clarification in agentic LLMs, with interest mainly in the research community studying tool use and planning.
notes: Focuses on proactive planning requiring clarification prediction and multi-agent framework evaluation.
